title: Xiangqi, Free Play, a composed scene: the round trip from a start that is not frozen
why: The start axis, end to end. The session is created from a composed position with Black to move, so its replay, its commits, its resume and the document it encodes all run from a start the core cannot look up — a build that substituted the frozen array anywhere would replay a different board and fail the first move. Black moving first is the second half of it: ply 0 is Black's, and the undo arithmetic must count back from the start's own side rather than from the ply's parity.
